items.excerpt: Arete-27B ran at 12.8 tokens per second on a free Kaggle notebook in the November 20 test. Ollama split its 17.2 GB file across two Tesla T4 cards, because one 16 GB card could not hold it alone.
items.title: Free 32GB VRAM on Kaggle runs a 27B model

items.excerpt: Ant Ling has open-sourced Ling-3.1-Flash under the MIT license for agent workflows that have to hold a goal across long stretches of work. In Ant's demonstration, an agent using it built a Lua-to-x86-64 compiler and passed 178 of 182 tests.
items.title: Ling-3.1-Flash is built for long-running agent workflows

items.excerpt: The two hours in MiniMind are the supervised fine-tuning stage, run for one epoch on a single RTX 3090. The guide pairs it with Kaggle's free GPU tier, 30 hours a week on dual T4s, with no card required.
items.title: Train a 64M LLM in 2 hours with MiniMind

items.excerpt: 我可以在免费 Kaggle T4 上跑一次刚发布的 SAM 3，用一句概念描述分割图片，并把能复跑的笔记本留给你。安装走官方源码，不用那个同名的 sam2 包。
items.title: 用一句话分割图片，在 Kaggle 上试 SAM 3

items.excerpt: On November 2, Anthropic added two sentences to Claude Code's Opus 5.5 prompt steering it away from recreating someone else's specific game. Version 2.1.317 softened the rule on November 4, so naming a game to describe the mechanics you want builds an original game in that genre.
items.title: Claude Code now refuses to clone existing games
